components.name: Aerodynamic Mode Control
components.description: Technical text control with a red pressed-state underline.
components.css: .ds-mode-switch{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);gap:32px}.ds-mode-switch button{background:transparent;color:var(--muted);padding:18px 0;font-family:Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .2s,border-color .2s}.ds-mode-switch button[aria-pressed=true]{color:white;border-color:var(--red)}.ds-mode-switch button:hover{color:white}.ds-mode-switch button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--red);outline-offset:6px}

narrative.overview: Silver car photography and film carry the atmosphere. Graphite surfaces, oversized italic lettering, red technical accents, and restrained body copy make the experience feel fast and precise. Large photographic blocks alternate with quieter information and fine dividers.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite and silver-white with purposeful red accents.
Condensed italic display type paired with compact, clear body text.
Square photography, thin rules, and outlined circular controls.
Airflow and wing movement as the signature interaction, with pause and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Red Roles Rule
rules.body: Keep display red for emphasis and technical states; keep the darker action red for the filled small-text CTA.

dos: Do lead with the supplied silver/red car imagery and preserve room for the car beneath oversized lettering.
Do pair italic display type with upright condensed numbers and Manrope body text.
Do keep square photographic blocks, fine dividers, visible focus, and circular utility controls.
Do preserve independent film controls, the animation pause action, and reduced-motion alternatives.
donts: Don't replace the darker filled CTA colors with display red.
Don't turn the editorial layout into a uniform rounded-card grid.
Don't introduce ornamental shadows or unrelated accent colors into the graphite/silver/red world.
Don't remove descriptive captions, accessible control names, or keyboard gallery behavior.
